exceptions_resolved_ck.name: exceptions_resolved_ck
exceptions_resolved_ck.value: ("exceptions"."status" IN ('RESOLVED','DISMISSED')) = ("exceptions"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "exceptions"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL)

po_sod_ck.name: po_sod_ck
po_sod_ck.value: "purchase_orders"."approved_by" IS NULL OR "purchase_orders"."requested_by" IS NULL OR "purchase_orders"."approved_by" <> "purchase_orders"."requested_by"

po_manual_approval_ck.name: po_manual_approval_ck
